name: Chief Roi Mata’s Domain
description: Chief Roi Mata's Domain spans three sites on the Vanuatu islands of Efate, Lelepa and Artok, all tied to a powerful chief who lived around 1600. They include his home, the place where he died and the island burial ground where many people were laid to rest with him. Vanuatu's first World Heritage Site, it shows how local oral tradition and archaeology tell the same story, and his peacemaking ideals still guide communities today.
